(2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of another white bowl containing clear noodle soup topped with fresh green cilantro, onions, and thin slices of cooked beef. The camera pans slightly across the surface of the soup. This is followed by a small black bowl of red chili oil being poured into the soup using a small ladle. The interior of the restaurant is shown with wooden tables, black leather booths, and large windows.
